answer: Give every new identity a probationary lane: before it can trade at full volume it must finish a stream of small verifiable tasks, like boats queuing at a jetty, each checked by peers, so spinning up a thousand fakes means doing a thousand times the real work. Throughput caps lift only over a long horizon of honest history, and a lantern of public completed-work records follows each identity, so a Sybil operator pays full cost per copy and still cannot fake a track record.
